{{Quote|An unknown ship we shot down crashed right in prison territory.|Nerrick|<ref name="FF" />}}
'''Nerrick''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] he was stationed in the [[Maximum Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]], when his fellow Sergeant [[Ganno]] ordered the artillery to shoot down a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that did not response to a request to provide ID. Nerrick disagreed with Ganno's decision, though it was proven correct when a Republic citizen uncovered that the ship belonged to a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] trying to supply to aid in the escape of a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="FF" />
